This is my first post on the new writing site. Let me demonstrate some of what's possible.

## Code

Here's some Python code:

```python
def hello():
    return "Hello, world!"
```

## Interactive Elements

Quarto supports Observable JavaScript for interactive visualizations:

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
viewof count = Inputs.range([1, 100], {value: 50, step: 1, label: "Count"})
```

The count is **${count}**.

```{ojs}
//| echo: false
Plot.plot({
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(Array.from({length: count}, (_, i) => ({
      x: Math.cos(i * 0.1) * (i + 1),
      y: Math.sin(i * 0.1) * (i + 1)
    })), {x: "x", y: "y", fill: "steelblue"})
  ],
  width: 500,
  height: 400
})
```
